title: Deterministic specialization for iPRA
mathematical_results: Clause Use needs no numerical target: newest clause uses 1; all older clauses use newest eigenparameter.
Exact consequence equivalence with unrestricted zero-normal uniform-Step clause calculus, proved by persistent premise procedures, formula-rank recursion, and source-proof-height recursion.
Ordinary realization is whole-domain bi-interpretable and equiconsistent with full first-order iPRA; equality is actual equality and numerical composites have graph x=y.
Refl, Step, Use, DE, DI are the complete primitive rule inventory; zero-normalization and every scope condition are specified.
proof_status: Written universal proofs and independent review with executable tests; no new Lean or Rocq formalization.
limits: No absolute or repository-wide minimum is proved.
The rule change alone ties tokens and adds one AST node; do not claim Pareto improvement from it alone.
The 820-byte supplement is the unchanged native Eq/Q/D calculus, not a compact implementation of the new deterministic theory.
A finite source proof produces a finite target proof, but no polynomial output bound is claimed.
Largest main fixture: 699 compact JSON bytes to 175640 bytes.
Whole standalone-checker scope-state equivalence concerns entry at the empty context, not arbitrary external calls to an open helper.
Interpreter resource bounds may reject sufficiently large valid finite certificates.
